value_or_null.description: Supplied21-page HHS author manuscript of Clin Cancer Res2015;21(5):1161-1171, PMC availability2017August25 is not new study date. Native locators use manuscript Page1-21, not invented final-journal page alignment. Separate online supplement not included/read.

MM L363/JJN3/KMS11 from MichaelKuehl NCI, KMS11-GFP engineered; lab explicitly did not authenticate these lines. U266 appears in Fig2 but its supplier not silently assigned. Patient ex-vivo and PBMC controls distinct from cultures and mouse tumors.

Rit40uM72h Fig1A versus40uM/DMK1.25mM48h rescue; OCR Rit20uM/Met5mM17h; Fig2MTS Rit20uM/Met1mM72h, patientMet5mM24/48/72h and PBMCMet1/5mM72h. Western Rit40uM/Met5mM72h. Do not pool doses or MTS with Annexin death.

Glucose/glutamine withdrawal lowers viability and DMK1.25mM partially rescues Rit40uM plus glutamine-deprived KMS11 at48h. Actual metabolic rescue, not rescue of Met combination or direct proof of sole glutamine flux/GLUT4 binding/sole complexI mechanism. Etomoxir minimal effect is data-not-shown and fatty-acid contribution not excluded.

Body says combination completely suppressed OCR, but Fig1D shows nonzero residual OCR and Met-alone and pair curves largely overlapping. Retain lower OCR versus Rit-only without claiming zero respiration or separately proven pair increment over Met. Equal viable cell numbers and5 wells/condition in representative of3 experiments are not15 biological replicates. No independent raw flux recomputation.

OCR after oligomycin5uM/FCCP5uM/antimycin+rotenone2uM each, source calls final step spare respiratory capacity. No independent basal/ATP-linked/maximal/spare-respiration calculation or substrate isotope tracing; do not silently relabel supplied claims as newly quantified flux.

Pair improves culture MTS/Annexin response with model-specific differences. Actual Chou/CompuSyn1 CI table for L363/JJN3/KMS11 ED50/75/90/95 is retained; not independent raw dose-matrix/model-fitting reproduction. CI from apoptosis IC50 Rit45uM/Met10mM, not MTS20uM/1mM or validated clinical synergy. No CIs for all models/donors.

Four displayed labels Pt1/Pt6/Pt8/Pt10 with72/72/24/48h exposures, not10patients or randomized clinical treatment. Total donor N/selection/clinical disease-stage/resistance history and unique sample overlap not verified. Written consent and Northwestern IRB approval as reported, no approval identifier.

Body contrasts MM response with normal PBMCs, but Fig2 PBMC pair atMet5mM visibly reduces viability; Met1mM pair less affected, not complete normal-cell sparing or clinical safety. Captionn5 does not establish five unique donors. MTS cancer readout versus PBMCAnnexin is not a direct selectivity-index estimate.

Methods NOD/SCID CB17 strain394 aged5-6weeks versus Fig3 caption BNX-SCID. Unresolved strain identity, not harmonized. Sex, allocated N per group, randomization/blinding and explicit animal ethics approval details not identified main; representative blot4/5 is not animal allocationN.

KMS11-GFP10million SC/Matrigel, Rit50mg/kg daily oral gavage, Met125mg/kg daily IP. Two vehicle arms/two single-agent/two sequential pair arms; second drug added after one week. Met-first and Rit-first separate, not simultaneous pair from day0. Human surface-area dose equivalence and achievable exposure are author rationale, not measured oral human PK.

Met-alone tumor growth initially restrained then increases afterday14; combination sequences show different trajectories. Body Rit regression2500to1500mm3 appears to compare vehicle/treatment levels rather than a verified2500-to1500 longitudinal regression in Rit arm; retain attribution, no invented within-arm estimate. Day14 normalized fold plots and tumor weights at sacrifice have distinct times/bases; exact graph means not digitized.

Body says no vehicle survival afterday14,50%or more Rit/Met alive atday21 and>50% combination throughday35; Fig3D order-specific curves do not support uniform versions of those statements, especially Rit-first pair reaching zero earlier. Preserve unresolved body/curve and order-specific survival bounds. No replacement medians/HRs/event counts or inferred cause; endpoint/euthanasia/censoring/risk-set details not given.

Body reports weight not significantly decreased and infers tolerability/glucose homeostasis, but no glucose/insulin homeostasis measurement supplied. Met-first pair weight bar is below baseline; graph alone not full significance/toxicity analysis. Bodyweight is not comprehensive organ/metabolic safety, and no direct clinical tolerability tested here.

Body claims pAKT/pAMPK suppression in5of5 pair tumors; Fig4C pair lane4 retains strong pAKT, Fig4A L363 pair pAKT remains strong and JJN3 pair pAMPK is not uniformly reduced. Source also acknowledges AMPK inconsistency between cells/tumors. No uniform all-model/all-mouse signaling suppression accepted; qualitative blots not normalized kinase-activity measures.

MCL1 and AKT/mTOR/AMPK associations retained as marker findings with nonuniform bands/representative tumor selection. MCL1mRNA unchanged and proteasome/GSK3 inhibition failing rescue are data-not-shown. No actual MCL1 genetic rescue/necessity, direct Met complexI binding or exclusive GLUT4 target mechanism established by these assays.

Representative vehicle tumor shows GLUT4 at invasion front/GLUT1 more diffuse. Fig3F caption says GLUT4 removed upon cotreatment, yet displayed images are vehicle-only. No accepted demonstrated treatment removal, dissemination/bone-lesion benefit or clinical metastasis mechanism from these images.

DLBCL/mantle/melanoma MTS72h with Rit20uM plusMet.1/1/5mM and doxorubicin10uM are other-model context. Some single-agent/lower-dose responses nonmonotonic; not all pair arms more effective than each single or formally synergistic. Breast/ovary only unchecked supplementaryS1 narrative; CLL efficacy is prior cited study, not own new MM outcome.

FDA approval is for original uses, not approved MM treatment. mM culture Met and high uM Rit, IP mouse Met and author human-equivalence arguments do not demonstrate actual human tumor exposure, survival or safe combination dosing. Cited HIV lipodystrophy experience is not an MM treatment trial or independently read safety evidence here.

Reuse same report across MM/other-model findings; multiple doses/assays/patient times and representative tumor blots are not new independent cohorts. Prior GLUT4 McBrayer2012 and CLL Adekola2014 studies remain cited context, not fresh read. No cross-corpus donor/tumor independence adjudication or new clinical trial/patient count.

MeanSEM n3 for selected culture assays, OCR5 wells within3 experiments, PBMCcaptionn5, other assays/donors/mouse allocationN unknown. Fig3 asterisk/P caption malformed and global testing/multiplicity/power/attrition plan unspecified. No exact graph aggregate digitization or P reconstruction.
